meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 给它产品名称、卖点、目标用户，它会按四段结构写出带 emoji 的标题和正文 Markdown 文案；也能改写已有文案的标题、正文和 emoji。
howto.when: 需要为电商商品创作或优化营销图片文案时触发，涵盖智能家居、数码配件、环保生活等产品类型。

say.text: 帮我给一款便携充电宝写电商图片文案，卖点是大容量和快充
say.note: 它会先问你要产品信息，再按四段结构出稿

say.text: 把这条眼罩文案的标题改得更吸睛，加点 emoji
say.note: 走文案优化流程，输出 Markdown 格式

say.text: 给环保餐具写一版文案，目标用户是上班族
say.note: 会挑选环保生活类模板来写

howto.what_en: Give it a product name, selling points and target users, and it writes Markdown ad copy with an emoji headline and a four-part body; it can also rewrite an existing headline, body and emoji.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to create or optimize e-commerce marketing image copy, covering smart home, digital accessories and eco-friendly products, etc.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for a power bank, highlighting fast charging
say_en.note: It asks for product details first, then drafts the copy

say_en.text: Make this eye mask headline more catchy and add some emoji
say_en.note: Runs the copy-optimization flow, Markdown output

say_en.text: Write copy for eco-friendly tableware aimed at office workers
say_en.note: Picks the eco-living template for the draft
